definition: A statement provided by an S corporation to each shareholder reporting the shareholder's pro rata share of the corporation's income, deductions, credits, and other tax items for the tax year.

includes.text: Reports shareholder's allocable share of business income and losses
Contains multiple categories of income items including ordinary business income, rental income, capital gains, and dividends
Includes deduction and credit information for shareholder use
Provides basis and passive activity limitation information

excludes.text: Return that allocates income to partners via separate statements
Entity-level return reporting total partnership income and deductions
Individual self-employed business income reported on sole proprietor return

discriminators.text: Reports S corporation shareholder's share with multiple income and deduction categories; the sibling reports partner's share from a partnership with different allocation structure
Shareholder statement of allocated items; the sibling is the entity-level return showing aggregate corporate income and deductions
Allocates S corporation income among shareholders with basis and passive activity tracking; the sibling reports self-employed individual business income on a single return
